about.title: ART THAT YOU CAN WALK ON
about.intro: Experts in carpet production, dedicated to quality, efficiency, and design solutions tailored to each project—crafted to international standards with precision.
about.talentDesc: Carpets are our craft, but our people and service are our true strength.
about.communicationDesc: Collaboration transforms your vision into crafted designs ready for production.
about.commitmentDesc: Not just making carpets right—doing what's right in every detail.
about.highlight1: Vertically integrated and agile—connecting design, sales, and production for faster, sharper execution.
about.highlight2: Owning hand-tufted facilities and partnering with a network of Axminster mills ensures quality control and competitive value.
about.highlight3: A 550-strong team united by craft and accountability—dedicated to excellence in every detail.

craftsmanship.title: Craftsmanship
craftsmanship.body: We treat carpet-making as both art and discipline. Every weave, tuft, and shade is shaped with intent—transforming wool, nylon, and viscose into living surfaces that respond to light and depth. Each piece carries the imprint of human touch and the rigor of craft, made to be felt as much as seen.
craftsmanship.unCaption: UN HQ NYC · Oman Heritage Walk

specialization.title: Specialization
specialization.subtitle: From hand-tufted masterpieces to Axminster innovations — our craftsmanship spans artistry, technology, and versatility.
specialization.handTuftedDesc: Where color, texture, and form converge — every rug a signature work of art.
specialization.axminsterDesc: Expertly woven in 7-pitch precision with up to 16 colors — a seamless balance of strength and artistry.
specialization.handAxDesc: Where artisanal warmth meets Axminster precision — the perfect harmony of handcraft and technology.
specialization.axTilesDesc: Modular precision meets Axminster craftsmanship — refined aesthetics in a practical format.
specialization.printedCarpetDesc: Precision dye-printing offers limitless creative freedom — vibrant color and seamless gradient expression.
specialization.machineTuftedDesc: Bespoke shapes, sculpted textures, and tailored edges — design pieces crafted for each interior.

markets.title: Our Capabilities & Services
markets.bodyA: From design collaboration to final installation, we craft bespoke flooring with precision and artistry.
markets.bodyB: Rooted in Hong Kong and the U.S., supported by production expertise in China, TCC blends craftsmanship and innovation for the world's most distinguished interiors.
